params.caption: 🎮 Take-Two CEO calls $80 GTA 6 a "bargain" Speaking to CNBC, Strauss Zelnick admitted consumers are under pressure from inflation, with food and gas prices way up. Still, he argues GTA 6 at $80 is good value because of the sheer number of hours players will get out of it, a week before its November 19 launch. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 23:14 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot #GTA6 #TakeTwo #GamingNews
